story.start: In the magical land of ${poi.prismia}, ${poi.rainbowvillage} is the source of all joy and color. Every day, the skies sparkle with beautiful rainbows that bring happiness to everyone. However an evil thief named ${enemy.mainbaddie} stole all the colors, turning ${poi.rainbowvillage} into a gray and gloomy place. Without the colors, the flowers wilt, the animals are sad, and the sky is dull. Please go and save all the colors of the rainbow so we may once again shine brightly!
lumina.start: At last! The ${name.rainbowriders} are here to save the day! You're the only ones who are strong enough to get back all the colors of the rainbow! Please go and defeat the evil ${enemy.mainbaddie} and restore ${poi.rainbowvillage} to it's once beautiful state. You are our ownly hope - good luck!
lumina.hasgreen: You got the color green! I knew you would be the the perfect ones to recover the rainbow! You must now save the rest of the colors so we can restore the rainbow and make ${poi.rainbowvillage} a bright and colorful place again!
jon.start: You should go talk to ${name.lumina} by the waterfall. She is in the North East of ${poi.rainbowvillage}.
jon.givegold: Here, take this with you to help you on your journey.
jon.goodluck: Good luck, I know you can do it!
green.prebattle: Ah . . . the famous ${name.rainbowriders}. I knew you'd come for green first. Too bad for you, since you'll never be able to take it from me!
green.postbattle: This isn't over, you may have gotten the color green back, but I still have the rest of the rainbow! You'll never get those!!
yellow.prebattle: You really think you're going to get the color Yellow from me? Hahaha, I'd like to see you try!
yellow.postbattle: NO!! You might have two colors now, but you'll never take the rest from me, I won't let you!
blue.prebattle: Ugh, you again? I'll never let you take blue from me!
blue.postbattle: ENOUGH! You think because you now have green, yellow, and blue that you'll get the last three colors!? NEVER!
orange.prebattle: How do you keep finding me?? Well, it doesn't really matter because you are never getting orange!
orange.postbattle: GRRR!!! You might have clawed orange from my hands, but I still have two colors left and they'll never be yours!
purple.prebattle: How did you make it all the way down here? It doesn't matter, PURPLE is mine and you'll never take it!
purple.postbattle: I can't believe this! At least I still have RED and you'll never get that from me!
red.prebattle: I've been expecting you! I knew you'd come for RED... too bad you'll never get it from me!
red.postbattle: THIS CAN'T BE HAPPENING! You've taken all the colors from me! Too bad for you, that you'll never catch me though!
colors.rainbow: You've restored all the colors to ${poi.rainbowvillage}, you really are the ${name.rainbowriders}! Thank you so much for being brave and saving the day!
info.wyndric: This is the statue of the great Wyndric the Wizard who founded ${poi.rainbowvillage}!
info.iceTeleport: This magic circle looks like it's missing one stone to complete it, perhaps you can find it?
item.green: This is the Green color of the Rainbow!
item.yellow: This is the Yewllow color of the Rainbow!
item.blue: This is the Blue color of the Rainbow!
item.purple: This is the Purple color of the Rainbow!
item.orange: This is the Orange color of the Rainbow!
item.red: This is the Red color of the Rainbow!
info.gotIceTeleportKey: You recieved the Ice Palace Magic Stone!
info.placeIceTeleportKey: You place the Magic Stone from the King of the North in the center of the magic circle...
npc.shipkingquest: Ah, the famous ${name.rainbowriders}, I have heard of the evil deeds of ${enemy.mainbaddie}. It is a shame what has befallen ${poi.rainbowvillage}. I'm afraid all I can offer you is the use of my ship that you can use to sail in the deep blue waters of ${poi.prismia}. I hope this aids you on your journey!
npc.iceking.quest: I am the King of the North, but I was cursed to be trapped in ice forever... all I can give you is this Magic Stone to use the magic circle withn my castle.
npc.icethiefinfo: I've been trying activate the magic circle in the far right right room, it looks like it's missing a magic stone, if only I could find it...
animal.pig.sad: Oink! I'm so sad with all the colors of the rainbow gone!
animal.cat.sad: Meow! I'm so sad with all the colors of the rainbow gone!
animal.fox.sad: Keke! I'm so sad with all the colors of the rainbow gone!
animal.goose.sad: Honk! I'm so sad with all the colors of the rainbow gone!
